title: Total film count

question: What are the top 5 departure airport IDs by number of scheduled flights?

title: Film title and category name
question: List 10 films along with their category names.
groundTruthSql: SELECT f.title, c.name AS category_name FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id LIMIT 10

title: Actors in a specific film
question: List the actors who appeared in the film 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'.
groundTruthSql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

title: Flights with airline name
question: List 5 flights showing the flight number and the airline name.

title: Film and language join
question: List 10 film titles and their corresponding language name.
groundTruthSql: SELECT f.title, l.name AS language FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id LIMIT 10

title: Airplanes and airline carrier
question: Show 5 airplanes with their capacity and airline name.

title: Inventory count per store
question: How many inventory items are stored at each store ID?

title: Film count per actor
question: List the top 5 actors who appeared in the most films.
groundTruthSql: SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 5

title: Departure airport details
question: Show flight number and departure airport city for 5 flights.

title: Film rental frequency
question: What are the 5 most rented films by title?
groundTruthSql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 5

title: Flights between specific airports
question: How many flights depart from airport ID 1 to airport ID 2?

title: Films with above-average length
question: How many films have a length strictly greater than the overall average film length?
groundTruthSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film)

title: Category with highest average rate
question: Which film category has the highest average rental rate?
groundTruthSql: SELECT c.name, AVG(f.rental_rate) AS avg_rate FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY avg_rate DESC LIMIT 1

title: Airlines with above average fleet capacity
question: Which airlines have an average airplane capacity greater than the fleet-wide average?
groundTruthSql: SELECT al.airlinename, AVG(ap.capacity) AS avg_cap FROM airline al JOIN airplane ap ON al.airline_id = ap.airline_id GROUP BY al.airline_id, al.airlinename HAVING avg_cap > (SELECT AVG(capacity) FROM airplane)

title: Films never rented
question: How many films in inventory have never been rented?
groundTruthSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_id IS NULL

title: Revenue per category
question: What is the total revenue generated by each film category?
groundTruthSql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_sales FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5

title: Airports with both departures and arrivals
question: How many airports have scheduled departures as well as scheduled arrivals?
